messages.subject: Nvim-R 0.9.7 released
messages.body_plain:
Version 0.9.7 of Nvim-R was released today. The main changes are:
Require Vim >= 8.0.0 or Neovim >= 0.1.5.
Replaced R_nvimcom_wait (time in miliseconds) with R_wait (time in seconds).
Minor bug fixes.
